lines.say: Two revision sessions. Which one wins in the exam?
Session A: the same problem type, over and over.
A feels better while you're doing it.
B wins later, when it counts.
The exam never tells you which method to use.
Mixed practice makes you pick it yourself.
Offload builds your plan from your notes and deadlines.
It tests you, and brings old topics back before they fade.
You just click the link in your calendar and show up.
